8815bc6465 test: handle mainnet logs in combine_logs.py

Mainnet functional tests write debug.log directly under node0/.
The helper used to skip that log, but since #16973, the recursive glob finds it, but the regex still expects a chain subdirectory and raises AttributeError.

Derive the relative directory from the discovered path so the helper can include the mainnet node log in its output.

Github-Pull: #36982
Rebased-From: 4e1dc2e01511ef9328a54fbbf756cb8c159898a7

baf46aa6c1 guix: compute --build triplet when lowering, not at load time

building-on read %current-system when manifest_build.scm was loaded. guix
shell loads the manifest before it applies --system, so a
--system=aarch64-linux build on an x86_64 machine configured the aarch64
toolchain with --build=x86_64-guix-linux-gnu, and gcc-cross failed to
configure. Make building-on a procedure so each derivation uses its own
system. Native builds produce the same derivations as before.

Github-Pull: #36709
Rebased-From: d7a8360f4ef5ff90b71d87b15ec4c5048b9ea0a9

76b0e368ce depends: store local package tarballs in WORK_PATH instead of SOURCES_PATH

Local packages (packages with $(package)_local_dir set) are built from a
tarball of the local directory, which is regenerated at parse time when any
file in the directory is newer than the tarball. The tarball was stored in
SOURCES_PATH next to downloaded sources. But unlike downloaded sources, it has
no fixed name or hash identifying its contents, so when SOURCES_PATH is shared
between checkouts, a checkout can find another checkout's tarball, see no
newer files, and build from the wrong sources.

This happens reliably with contrib/guix/guix-build, which shares SOURCES_PATH
with its build container and mounts every checkout at /bitcoin inside it, so
all checkouts use the same tarball path. The host `make download-*` step it
runs first also sets the mtimes of local directory files to 2000-01-01, so no
checkout ever sees files newer than a tarball another checkout created.

Store local package tarballs and their download stamps in
WORK_PATH/local-sources instead. WORK_PATH defaults to the checkout's
depends/work directory, so each checkout gets its own tarball.

A side benefit is that when sources have been downloaded beforehand, as
guix-build does, building no longer writes to SOURCES_PATH, so a shared
SOURCES_PATH can be mounted read-only in build containers.

This change was written with Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context).

Github-Pull: #35765
Rebased-From: 01491f22b2c77d632e8503cc446140d1ab6ccc21

fe4101248d net: only use the select error set while connecting

Windows uses the select() error set to report a failed non-blocking
connect(). Make ErrorEvent an event that can be requested from
Sock::Wait(), like RecvEvent and SendEvent: with select() it adds the
socket to the error set. ConnectToSocket() requests it while
connecting. This is safe on all platforms, as any error condition is
worth waking for there.

All other uses of select() now leave the error set empty. With
select(), sockets waited on without ErrorEvent no longer wake up for
or report exceptional conditions, such as TCP urgent data on an
established connection. No behavior change with poll().

Add a unit test: with an urgent byte pending, waiting for RecvEvent
must not report ErrorEvent.
